fields.name: model
fields.description: This is a string that represents a manufacturer-allocated number used to identify the general type and/or category of the hardware item. This, in combination with the Part and the Vendor, identify different types of hardware items. The SerialNumber can then be used to differentiate between different instances of the same type of hardware item. This is an optional attribute.

fields.name: part
fields.description: This is a string that defines a manufacturer-allocated part number assigned by the organization that manufactures the hardware item. This, in combination with the Model and the Vendor, identify different types of hardware items. The SerialNumber can then be used to differentiate between different instances of the same type of hardware item. This is a REQUIRED attribute.

fields.name: sku
fields.description: This is a string that defines the manufacturer-allocated Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) number of the hardware item. This is an optional attribute.

fields.name: vendor
fields.description: This is a string that defines the name of the manufacturer. This, in combination with the Model and the Part, identify different types of hardware items. The SerialNumber can then be used to differentiate between different instances of the same type of hardware item. This is a REQUIRED attribute for a physical resource.

fields.name: hasNetworkInterface
fields.description: tell if UserEquipment has network interface(s)

fields.name: isWearable
fields.description: tell if UserEquipment is a wearable device
